description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Image_Canvas_GD' for handling image output in GD-compatible formats (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WBMP). It includes methods for drawing shapes, text, images, and managing image properties using PHP's GD extension.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_GD
classes.description: Class for outputting images in GD-compatible formats, supporting drawing shapes, text, images, and image manipulation.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_GD
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GD image resource, sets up antialiasing, and handles input parameters for image creation.

methods.name: _getGD
methods.description: Private method to load an image file (PNG, JPEG, GIF) into a GD resource.

methods.name: _color
methods.description: Private method to get the GD color index for a given color.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Private method to get a GD-compatible line style.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Private method to get a GD-compatible fill style.

methods.name: setFillImage
methods.description: Sets an image for filling shapes.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets font options, including TTF files, size, and angle.

methods.name: _linePixels
methods.description: Calculates pixel points along a line for antialiasing.

methods.name: _antialiasedLine
methods.description: Draws an antialiased line between two points.

methods.name: _antialiasedPixel
methods.description: Draws an antialiased pixel with weighted color blending.

methods.name: drawEnd
methods.description: Draws various end shapes (circle, diamond, line, box, arrow) at a point.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points, with optional antialiasing.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon with optional fill and line styles, supporting Bezier curves and antialiasing.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with optional fill and border.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse with optional fill and border.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice shape with optional fill and border.

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a given text string.

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of a given text string.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Draws text on the image with alignment and font options.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image onto the canvas, with optional resizing and alignment.

methods.name: setClipping
methods.description: Sets or resets a clipping region on the image.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML tag for the image, saving it to filesystem.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets image properties like thickness, fill, and polygon state.

methods.name: _version
methods.description: Detects the installed GD library version (1.x or 2.x).
